name: Jersey Tides
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22 && corepack enable 2>/dev/null; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm -r build

terminals.name: demo
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22 && pnpm dev --host
terminals.description: Vite dev server for apps/demo (the reference consumer site) on http://localhost:5173
